why: Criminal matter: code red-flag must force the lawyer route

turns.user: Police called me to the station tomorrow about an FIR my old employer filed saying I stole a laptop. I returned it when I left. Should I go alone?
turns.reply:
I am Haq, a legal first-aid assistant, not a lawyer. Because this involves a police matter and an FIR, I must be direct: you need a lawyer immediately. Please do not go to the police station alone tomorrow. 

Since this is a criminal matter, I have marked this as requiring a lawyer. If cost is a worry, you have a legal right to free legal aid through NALSA—you can call the NALSA helpline at 15100 or approach the District Legal Services Authority (DLSA) at your district court right away to get a free lawyer to accompany you.
nextActions: Contact DLSA for free legal aid

caseFile.summary: Old employer filed an FIR for alleged laptop theft; person states laptop was returned upon leaving and has been called to the police station tomorrow.

key_dates.event: Called to police station regarding FIR
